cases.title: 3-D: a point on a circle, on an empty canvas
cases.lookFor: A circle with D on it, no centre letter, the notice «נוצר מעגל חדש». «הציגו תצורה אחרת» changes the tilt and D stays on it. The view refits to the circle each time, so its size on screen stays about the same.

cases.title: 3-D: a radius stated first creates the circle
cases.lookFor: A circle, the notice, and in the data panel under «מדידות»: «רדיוס המעגל = 3». No number on the canvas, as in 2-D (a question for you). Beyond the plan, and ahead of 2-D, which sends this line to the AI.

cases.title: 2-D: a definition restated backwards says it already exists
cases.lookFor: «כבר קיים», no new row. You did not ask for this one.
cases.before: A second row that changed nothing.

cases.title: 2-D: a bagrut line typed reversed is refused and offers the right sentence
lines: שני מעגלים נחתכים בנקודות A ו-B
AD מיתר במעגל P משיק למעגל O בנקודה A
CB מיתר במעגל O משיק למעגל P בנקודה B
המשך AC חותך את מעגל P בנקודה E
cases.expectRefusal: המשך CA חותך את מעגל P בנקודה E
cases.lookFor: Refused, offering «המשך CA חותך את מעגל P בנקודה E». This reverses ADR-142, as you ruled.

cases.title: 2-D: a later line that makes the side impossible, on a free radius
lines: המשך AO חותך את מעגל P בנקודה R
cases.lookFor: «OP = 10» is refused, naming both statements, even though a circle P larger than 10 could have kept R past O. Does that read fair to a student?

cases.title: Analytic: free circles stay put as four tangents are added
lines: AB משיק משותף למעגלים O ו-K
CD משיק משותף למעגלים O ו-K
EF משיק משותף למעגלים O ו-K
GH משיק משותף למעגלים O ו-K
cases.lookFor: Four different lines, and input feels instant. Type the four lines yourself and watch: from the first tangent on, the circles and earlier tangents never move. The configurations cycle which tangent has which name.
cases.before: O, K and A moved with every tangent.

cases.title: Analytic: a later given still picks the tangent (riskiest)
lines: AB משיק משותף למעגלים O ו-K
הישר AB חותך את ציר ה-y מתחת לציר ה-x
CD משיק משותף למעגלים O ו-K
cases.lookFor: AB crosses the y-axis below the x-axis; CD is a different line; the panel lists AB with two equations («… או …»), since two tangents meet that given; C, D and CD read «—», since they still have more than two possible values. Known and not this case: the status still says «הציור נקבע במלואו», which is false, is the same on prod, and is #1596.
cases.before: AB the same; CD could share its line.

cases.title: 2-D: «AK אנך ל-BC» now puts K on BC
cases.lookFor: K on line BC, the foot from A. Behaviour change.
cases.before: K was created off BC, with AK perpendicular to BC.

cases.title: Analytic: «האליפסה היא כעת מעגל» moves to the blue strip
cases.lookFor: Blue ⓘ strip. Not in the plan's lines; a one-word revert if you disagree.

cases.title: 3-D: «וקטור u» and «חץ A'C» rows
cases.lookFor: An arrow over AB with no raw →; an arrow over A'C beside «חץ»; the row for «וקטור u» shows the underlined u alone. Beyond the reported rows.

cases.title: 2-D: «קשת AB = 2/3» is degrees, never the chord
cases.lookFor: The row reads ∠AOB = 2/3° as a typeset fraction, the arc is labelled 2/3°, no chord label, no raw decimal. The label is cramped on a sliver this thin: say if that is not good enough.

cases.title: 2-D: a pinned radius draws in every configuration
cases.lookFor: O, R and the circle are drawn in every configuration, all four rows green, OR = 5. The ⚠ note about the letter r is the existing notice on a committed row.
cases.before: Every configuration but the first was empty.

cases.expectRefusal: המשך OA חותך את מעגל P בנקודה R

lines: E על AC' כך ש-AE = t·p
cases.lookFor: The row reads as a sentence with «AE = t·p» typeset in order, no minus, no arrow on AC'. p is parallel to the diagonal. «הציגו תצורה אחרת» moves E and p's length; the cube keeps its size, though the view may refit to p's length.

cases.title: PR #2723: a letter on an existing segment

cases.lookFor: The last row reads with «KP = αu + βv» in order, no minus, no arrow on AM. P sits on AM.

cases.title: PR #2723: perpendicular to a segment

cases.title: PR #2724: the kite says which sides it chose
expect: הכלי לא יודע אילו צלעות שוות
cases.lookFor: The note, no equal-side ticks at rest (a relation is never a mark at rest), and «הציגו תצורה אחרת» swaps the pair.

cases.title: PR #2724: stating the pair settles it
cases.lookFor: The line is kept, the note goes, no more swapping.

cases.title: PR #2724: the other pair draws a kite
cases.lookFor: Axis BD, a kite and not a rhombus.

cases.title: PR #2724: main diagonal with the pair unstated
cases.lookFor: It builds; the row reads «האלכסון הראשי: -2x + y = 0» with «y = 2x» under it, analytic's usual form. Cycling puts A,C or B,D on the line. No equal-side ticks at rest. At this seed the kite can look nearly like a rhombus: press «הציגו תצורה אחרת» to see a clear kite, and say if that first drawing bothers you.

cases.title: PR #2724: pair stated after the line
cases.lookFor: The row becomes «AC: -2x + y = 0» with «y = 2x» under it, the note goes, A and C stay on the line, no ticks. No name on the line on the canvas, as for every line in analytic. At this seed the kite can look nearly like a rhombus: press «הציגו תצורה אחרת» to see a clear kite, and say if that first drawing bothers you.
cases.before: The line is AC from the start, and the pair says «כבר ידוע».

cases.title: PR #2724: the other pair after the line
cases.lookFor: The row reads «BD: -2x + y = 0», no ticks. Never a rhombus.
cases.before: A line AC on a rhombus.

cases.title: PR #2724: an open base in the panel and beside the side
cases.lookFor: The panel reads «הבסיס: x - 2y + 6 = 0»; the equation is beside the base and moves with it; the equal-sides note stays.

cases.title: PR #2724: equation and length on one side
cases.lookFor: Both are readable and do not overlap each other.

cases.title: PR #2724: a bare isosceles triangle shows no ticks
cases.lookFor: No ticks on any side; the note naming the drawn pair stays; «הציגו תצורה אחרת» still changes the pair. This changes a shape you know, so it is yours to see.
cases.before: 2 ticks on the pair the tool chose.

cases.title: PR #2724: a stated equality keeps its ticks
cases.lookFor: The row is kept, with 2 ticks.

cases.title: PR #2724: a value on an open seat stays
cases.lookFor: «5» on AB, no ticks.
